description: Link Road is a dataset listed in Ballarat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the future plan for the Ballarat Link Road. The information was collected from stage plans. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the future plan for the Ballarat Link Road. This dataset is static and is only updated if there is a change. Coverage: Ballarat, Victoria. The portal files it under Transport, Roads & Planning. Its keywords are roads, transport. The portal shows 1,225 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ballarat-vic-gov-au-portal.
